text: Valentin Golovanov is FONBET's managing shareholder.
short: FONBET's managing shareholder is Valentin Golovanov.

source.name: KHL press service: «10 лет на одной линии»: КХЛ и FONBET отмечают десятилетие партнёрства
source.note: Russian original; English: 'Valentin Golovanov, managing shareholder of FONBET' — speaker attribution in the league's official article marking ten years of the KHL-FONBET partnership.
